t: When everything feels like it is going wrong at once
a: اللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي أَعُوذُ بِكَ مِنْ عَذَابِ الْقَبْرِ، وَمِنْ عَذَابِ النَّارِ، وَمِنْ فِتْنَةِ الْمَحْيَا وَالْمَمَاتِ، وَمِنْ فِتْنَةِ الْمَسِيحِ الدَّجَّالِ
p: Allāhumma innī aʿūdhu bika min ʿadhābi-l-qabr, wa min ʿadhābi-n-nār, wa min fitnati-l-maḥyā wa-l-mamāt, wa min fitnati-l-Masīḥi-d-Dajjāl.
m: O Allah, I seek refuge in You from the punishment of the grave, from the punishment of the Fire, from the trial of living and of dying, and from the trial of the False Messiah.
